📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

6. Speculative Appetite?
Speculation remains weak: ARKK BELOW TREND (1W: -5.26% | 1M: -13.43%) and IBIT BELOW TREND (1W: -3.61% | 1M: -9.29%). Small caps are also BELOW TREND: IWM (1W: -0.14% | 1M: -1.27%), despite the small-versus-large ratio ↑ rising, ABOVE TREND (1W: +1.83% | 1M: +2.71%).

🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

Industrial metals are weak: CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -3.85% | 1M: -3.39%). Gold is also BELOW TREND: GLD (1W: -3.50% | 1M: -5.35%); the gold-versus-stocks ratio ↓ falling, BELOW TREND (1W: -1.53% | 1M: -2.94%).

8. Energy Trend?
Energy is in CORRECTION: XLE (1W: -2.24% | 1M: +5.09%), while USO is in CORRECTION (1W: -3.48% | 1M: +9.85%). Natural gas remains weak: UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.29% | 1M: -13.46%).

🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
Confirmed downside momentum in equities: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -1.99% | 1M: -2.64%) and XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -12.15%). Cross-asset divergence: TLT is in CORRECTION (1W: -0.64% | 1M: +5.19%) as VXX is ABOVE TREND (1W: +4.19% | 1M: +9.77%).

10. Portfolio Direction?
Cautious, selective positioning: favor defensive exposure via XLP ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.07% | 1M: +9.76%) and XLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.70% | 1M: +9.95%). Reduce exposure to tech weakness, with XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -12.15%); TLT in CORRECTION (1W: -0.64% | 1M: +5.19%) remains mixed.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

BEARISH: If tech weakness persists, reduce exposure to XLK BELOW TREND (1W: -6.85% | 1M: -12.15%).

12. Commodities to Watch?

BEARISH: If selling extends, watch UNG BELOW TREND (1W: -5.29% | 1M: -13.46%) and GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -3.50% | 1M: -5.35%).

13. Key Levels?
Credit ratio: HYG/LQD 0.7422, ↓ falling (1W: -0.45% | 1M: -1.89%), BELOW TREND. Stocks-versus-bonds ratio: 9.3003, ↓ falling (1W: -2.47% | 1M: -7.75%), BELOW TREND; tech-versus-financials ratio: 3.0864, ↓ falling (1W: -9.30% | 1M: -17.48%), BELOW TREND.

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION; Breadth: 9/11 sectors positive, indicating broad strength despite defensive risk signals.
Healthcare and Staples show relative strength, with a Value-over-Growth tilt.
Monitor rising fear and weakening credit and stocks-versus-bonds ratios against persistent tech weakness.
